column1: # THE REQUIRED SCENARIO SET, DECLARED. The spec leg's own header has said for as long as it has
# existed that each slice "holds it to the dialect's own required scenario set (set equality, never
# a floor -- see the sibling MCP `assert_covered`)". There was no such set. `voice-conform spec`
# enumerates whatever `.json` files it finds in the dialect directory and asserts only that the
# list is not EMPTY, so the battery's subject was whatever happened to be on disk. Planted: thirteen
# of the fourteen openai fixtures deleted. The leg reported
#     RESULT openai PASS session.update.json -- IR-fixpoint stable (1 IR event(s))
# and exited 0. Thirteen scenarios stopped being exercised and not one row said so; the leg went on
# printing the same green it prints for the full set.
# This file is that set. It is SET EQUALITY in both directions, checked by legs/spec-per-dialect.sh
# before the harness runs: a scenario named here with no file is a scenario that silently stopped
# being tested, and a file here with no line is a scenario nobody decided to test -- adding a
